positions.title: Master & Ph.D. Students
positions.body:
We are looking for motivated students to join our team. Ideal candidates should have a background or strong interest in:

- Food Engineering
- AI
- Simulation and Modeling
- Food Safety and Quality

Please email me with the subject heading "Prospective Student - [Your Name]" and include your CV, transcript, and a 1-page cover letter with a description of your relevant past research experience, your future research interests, and why you want to work with me.

positions.title: Postdoctoral Scholars
positions.body:
We are not currently conducting a formal postdoc search. However, if you believe you have a strong research fit and case for joining our lab, you can email me with the subject heading "Prospective PostDoc - [Your Name]" and include your CV and a 1-2 page cover letter with a description of your past research experience and what you would like to accomplish in our lab.

We welcome self-funded visiting students & scholars with intending 6 months or longer visit.

positions.title: Undergraduate Students
positions.body: We welcome undergraduate researchers. Please send me an email with the subject heading "Prospective undergraduate researchers - [Your Name]" and include your CV, transcript, and a 1-2 paragraph cover letter with a description of your past research experience (if any), your research interests, and why you want to work in my lab.
